player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Buccaneers''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]] list on DeckTech in May 2001.

starting.card: Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place

description: A Bring Him Before Me deck that beats the opponent down w/Emperor's Power and destiny adding characters.
cards: Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place
posted: Objective Bring Him Before/I hate the 7 side
Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith
posted: Always Thinking with Your Stomach
notes: No separate starting section is posted; the strategy says to always start Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points and Imperial Decree (with Prepared Defenses). All are in the list and count toward the 60; starting effect left blank because three Effects start.
Posted 'Objective Bring Him Before/I hate the 7 side' dested Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place; 'I hate the 7 side' is the poster's comment, not a card.
The 'Epic Event 1' and 'Admiral Order 1' section headers were mis-parsed as cards and removed.

Posted 'Endor' dested the Dark Endor (Dark); 'Endor Docking Bay' dested Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay) (Dark); 'CCDocking Bay' dested Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay); 'DSIIThrone Room' and 'DSIIDocking Bay' dested Death Star II: Throne Room and Death Star II: Docking Bay.

Posted 'Docking Bay' (the fourth of 'all of your Docking bays (4)') names no specific site (Spaceport Docking Bay, Coruscant: Docking Bay and Executor: Docking Bay all fit), so it is printed as written.

Posted 'DVDLOTS' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'EPP Vader' dested the Enhanced Premiere Darth Vader With Lightsaber (the strategy counts 5 Vaders); 'Ig-88 w/gun' dested IG-88 With Riot Gun; '4-Lom w/gun' dested 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Zuckuss/Bossk/Dengar in Ship' dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter, Bossk In Hound's Tooth and Dengar In Punishing One; 'Vader's Saber' dested Vader's Lightsaber.
Posted 'Mob. Points' and 'Imp. Decree' dested Mobilization Points and Imperial Decree.
Section counts as posted: Effects 12 (9 listed). The list totals 59 cards, kept as published. The strategy says Young Fool will be added; it is not in the list.
